transcript:
Hourly brief, Founders' Preview. Here is what is moving in superintelligence (SI), the next generation of artificial intelligence (AI).
DeepSeek released a V4.1 Flash update with wish-style programming and opened a search API, reported by OSCHINA in the open source developer community.
Anthropic unveiled an internal employment report showing artificial intelligence agents work 6 times longer than humans, ushering in the meta-work era, reported by 36Kr.
DeepSeek upgraded its programming model and opened a search API, charging 5 yuan per thousand calls, while Anthropic plans to raise 60 billion dollars to procure artificial intelligence chips and provide Blackstone with over 10 percent yield, reported by 21财经 in global tech news.
An exclusive 8000-word report covers the dramatic untold history of Codex's epic comeback against ChatGPT in its first public unveiling, reported by 36Kr.
Wang Ziru expressed desire to reconcile with Luo Yonghao, DeepSeek announced API web search and scraping fees, iPhone Duo scalper prices dropped from 58,000 RMB to 3,000 RMB, and Crazy Yang Ge's new account followers were wiped to zero, reported by 搜狐.
